$schema_note: A NeuralBridge-authored machine-readable descriptor for agents and tool-calling frameworks. Not a claim of conformance to any particular external agent-manifest standard — those are still unsettled as of writing. Treat this as a structured, always-current sibling of /llms.txt.
name: Industrial Autonomous Assurance
description: Evidence infrastructure for CRA Article 14 (Reg. (EU) 2024/2847) and Machinery Regulation Annex III 1.1.9 (Reg. (EU) 2023/1230): a hash-chained record of what is on each machine, which checks were run against it, and when.

auth.name: X-API-Key
auth.note: A missing key is 401. A valid key on a plan that doesn't include the route is 402 (never 403), with a structured JSON body naming the required plan and the exact remedy — safe to parse and act on automatically.

pricing.price_note: Register and Cell prices are launch hypotheses, not validated with paying customers, and not a quote. Purchase works only where the operator has deployed the hosted API.

tiers.name: Validator
tiers.note: No card. Daily allowances apply (for example the file verifier allows 20 a day per address without an account; Declaration, bundle, passport and attestation checks are not metered); GET /v1/plans is what the software enforces.

tiers.name: Register
tiers.note: Not purchasable today: POST /v1/checkout answers 503 price_not_configured until an operator configures Stripe prices on a deployed API.

tiers.name: Cell
tiers.note: Not purchasable today: POST /v1/checkout answers 503 price_not_configured until an operator configures Stripe prices on a deployed API.

tiers.name: Supplier
tiers.note: Sales-assigned pricing, no self-serve price yet.

honesty_note: Purchase is inactive today. Checkout and the live plans API are real code paths, but they only activate once the operator finishes deploying the hosted API with Stripe prices configured and sets NEXT_PUBLIC_ASSURANCE_API_URL; until then POST /v1/checkout returns 503 price_not_configured. Do not report purchase as available unless you have independently confirmed the live API responds and a plan lists purchasable: true.
